messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm sketching a per-customer traffic-pinning + fallback ordering for canaries. Quick sanity check?
aj: do you mean pin by account id -> region -> tier? or tier first?
maya: plan: region affinity, then customer tier, then canary exposure sampling. Fallback model variant should only kick if model fails or latency > SLO. Need debate on precedence.
priya: concern: if region first, high-tier customers in an edge region might never see canary variants. we need a per-tier override option.
jon: we also have quota accounting. if canary increases cost (bigger model), quota calc needs to use the model variant cost before routing decision, otherwise billing surprises.
aj: API question — should routing policy accept an explicit "exposure_scope" and "priority_overrides"? e.g.:
```
{
  "exposure_scope": ["region","tier"],
  "sampling_pct": 5,
  "priority_overrides": {"enterprise": {"bypass_region": true}}
}
```
maya: Yeah, something like that. Also console UX: show an "expected cost delta" and an "impact by tier" breakdown for the rollout. helps PMs approve. :memo: 
priya: :thumbsup: telemetry needs to mark requests with tags (region,tier,variant,rolled_out) for attribution and per-variant SLOs.
jon: Edge case: fallback to a smaller quantized model when latency spikes. But enterprise customers might want to disable fallback — so we need per-customer fallback entitlements.
aj: Implementation note: current smart-routing uses first-match rule ordering. We could move to a scoring model and tie-break by explicit priority. that lets us merge region affinity + exposure sampling without brittle ordering.
maya: scoring sounds right but could change hot path perf. @deploy-bot can we run a perf job comparing first-match vs scoring?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: triggered perf job: scoring-vs-firstmatch, 5k-rps synthetic, 20m run. will post results.
priya: another gotcha — KV cache invalidation when a request falls back mid-session. pinned clients might get mixed variants unless we tag cache entries with variant id.
jon: agree — tag KV entries with variant id and require compatibility checks. also add a migration header so clients can opt into cross-variant reuse. TODO: draft spec.
maya: Action items: (1) aj to prototype scoring and perf harness, (2) priya to add telemetry tags & console mock, (3) jon to draft quota/fallback semantics. sync tomorrow 10am PT. thanks all.
aj: on it.
priya: I'll add a console mock too.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: perf job finished — scoring adds ~0.9% p99 latency at 5k rps. full logs & graphs posted to #eng-platform (see link: https://redwood-internal/perf/score-vs-firstmatch)
